summary: The latest branch is oodialog-qt6-v0.15 (commit 5cc1c57), renderer v0.15.0, based on and tested against oodialog-wasm e2e7899 (v0.25.0, which includes v0.24.0). All 65 of the suite's tests pass, offscreen and on an X server (Xvfb with Qt's xcb platform), with the designer's programs and the print kit. New in v0.15.0: scroll bars (SCROLLBAR, sb.* ops, SB events; t26), property sheet pages inserted and removed while shown (t27), scattered natives (t28: list box hit tests, list-view column changes and alignment, tab rectangles, track bar selection, key state, group box title alignment, childAt, tool tip colours, margin and size), popupAsChild sheets (t29), user messages and the notifications every control has (t30), and the page calls keyDown and topDialog. In v0.14.0: the re-bar (REBAR, rb.* ops; t25_rebar) and a dialog kept within reach (t24_fit): moved into the screen's free area at first show and when that area changes; a desktop window is not scaled, so one larger than the area goes to its top left. In v0.13.0: the tool bar (TOOLBAR, tb.* ops; t23_toolbar), custom draw of list-views and tree-views (cd.on, CD ROWS events, cd.paint; upstream customDrawListview.rex with 1,000 rows and treeViewCustomDraw.rex, unchanged, as up10), tv.kids and tv.order (sortChildrenCB), lv.insRow answering the uid, and data file names in strings for the runner's Windows names (oodfiles.js 0.2.0). In v0.12.0: the standby printer of v0.20.0 (deliver: the file is written to a folder and shown in a window with Print through CUPS lp, Open through xdg-open, Save and Close; a PDF shows as pages through pdftoppm; test print/t19_print, run with --pdfkit, the PDF classes oodialog-wasm's tools/oodpdfkit.rex collects); and v0.21.0's natives: the status bar (STATUSBAR, sb.* ops; t22_statusbar), windowAt, list-view rows by uid (t20_lvrows), edit lines, cue banners, tab sizes, padding, tab stops, item uids and row heights (t21_natives), the dialog's own colour, and the focused control's id in a KEY event. The build now needs Qt6 PrintSupport. In v0.11.0: KEY events with Windows virtual-key codes (demo/calckeys), and three demo samples checked with real X input through xdotool. In v0.10.0: pagedTab. In v0.9.0: tool tips. In v0.8.0: the month calendar, ResizingAdmin. The suite is the browser harness's tests, with their .steps and .expect files, plus the three programs the ooDialog Designer generates (Calculator, Contacts, Gadgets), used unchanged as a contract test. Every one of upstream's sample programs was also started with nothing clicked: against v0.25.0 (offscreen) 87 of 122 programs showed their dialog (86 against v0.22.0 and v0.23.0, 84 against v0.19.0 to v0.21.0). 32 errors remain, all in oodWeb.cls's scope; none is in the renderer: winsystm.cls 19, resource reader not set 9, ooDialog native functions oodWeb does not have yet 2 (RI_INIT, CDI_INIT), other 2. Since 15 Nov 2026 this chat owns Linux ooDialog (Tom's rule).
